regime.summary: Policy rate 15.0% after a 250bp cut, bills at 12.00% price further cuts, CPI fell from 9.64% to 4.86%. Cut and falling-CPI base rates lean positive but are n=3 and n=10 and weak. Index is up 43.8% in 3m and 21.3% in 1m, so the move is extended; hold some, do not chase.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 15.0%; last MPC decision 2024-11-04: cut (-250bp)
CPI YoY 4.86% for 2024-11 (published by 2024-12-03); three months earlier (2024-08) 9.64%

core.thesis: Cheap on earnings and paying a large dividend, and not extended: only 2.7% under its 252-day high with a 1m gain of 2.5% against the market's 21%. Yield carries the position if rates keep falling. Foreign selling in fertilizer is a risk.

Power is the laggard sector (3m +12.1% against the index's +43.8%). HUBC sits 22.4% under its high at a P/E near 3 and a 12.3% yield, so it is not extended. Rate cuts help a leveraged utility. Low conviction.

contamination_note: No post-2024-12-13 memory used. base_rates.csv carries its own warning that it was measured on data through 2026-10-16, so I used it only as rough odds for types and not for names or dates.
